messages.body_plain:
Hi R folks,

We'll be holding potentially one of the last worksessions for this quarter from 10am-12pm today. Stay tuned for future information on summer scheduling, as well as fall plans. Please come join if you can!

Zoom link <https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/94341983677?pwd=QmhybkJDR0JtNGh5MWhGVy9QR0I3QT09>

Thanks,
Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators

--

John Muir (My First Summer in the Sierra, 1911)
